Market Factors

What Affects the Gold Rate in Sargodha?

International Gold Prices

Global gold-market movements can influence the underlying local reference rate.

USD / PKR Exchange Rate

Currency movement can affect the Pakistani rupee value of internationally priced gold.

Local Market Conditions

Supply, demand, trading activity and local quotations can affect the figure customers see.

Purity & Weight

Different karats and different weights produce different gold values even on the same day.

Helpful Gold Information

Gold Buying & Price Comparison

Confirm the Karat

Confirm the Weight

Make sure both quotations use the same unit: tola, 10 gram or gram.

Ask for a Breakdown

For jewellery, separate the gold value from making, stone, wastage and other agreed charges.

Check the Timing

A published market reference may differ from a later shop quotation if the market moves.

Common Questions

Gold Rate FAQs

What is the gold rate today in Sargodha?

The published Sargodha snapshot used on this static page lists 24K gold at Rs. 441,000 per tola, with 22K at Rs. 404,358, 21K at Rs. 385,978, 20K at Rs. 367,598 and 18K at Rs. 330,838 per tola, dated 30 September 2026.

What is today's gold rate in Sargodha per gram?

For the rate snapshot shown here, the displayed 24K reference is Rs. 37,203 per gram. The 22K, 21K, 20K and 18K per-gram figures shown on this page are rounded reference conversions from the corresponding 10-gram values.

What is the 21K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The displayed 21K reference is Rs. 385,978 per tola and Rs. 330,829 per 10 gram, with an approximate reference of Rs. 33,083 per gram.

What is the 24K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The displayed 24K rate is Rs. 441,000 per tola and Rs. 378,090 per 10 gram, while the page shows Rs. 37,203 as the published per-gram reference.

How many grams are in one tola of gold?

One tola is approximately 11.664 grams.

Is the gold rate the same as the final jewellery price?

No. The displayed gold rate is a market reference. A finished jewellery item's final price may also include workmanship, design, stone work, wastage and other applicable charges.

Why can two websites show different gold rates?

Different published figures can reflect different update times, market locations, valuation methods or buy/sell sides. Compare the date, purity and unit before treating two numbers as equivalent.
